$description: Spoken Letter design tokens — Direction 01 'Across'. Source of truth for the app theme; the exhaustive design-token parity contract checks the committed src/app/globals.css runtime projection. Palette: Cream ground, Lamplight amber hero accent, Clay-rose + Dusk-plum supports, Evening-ink text. Type: Newsreader (display) + Mulish (body).
